description: Output specification for the ISM forensics pipeline. All outputs must be generated under /app/output/. The pipeline should extract raw data supporting each finding, produce a structured diagnosis, and emit corrected policy files where applicable.

extraction_outputs.description: Raw data extractions from cluster state. Each file is a JSON array sorted by index name.

failed_actions.json.description: Every index where an ISM action is currently in a failed state

item_fields.consumed_retries: integer — retries consumed for this action
item_fields.error_message: string — error detail from the ISM explain info

policy_mismatches.json.description: Indices running a policy version that differs from the current policy definition

item_fields.index_policy_seq_no: integer — policy version the index is currently running
item_fields.current_policy_seq_no: integer — latest _seq_no from the policy definition file

rollover_chains.json.description: Rollover chains reconstructed by grouping indices by their common prefix

item_fields.indices: array of string — all indices in the chain, sorted ascending
item_fields.rolled_count: integer — count of indices that have completed rollover
item_fields.write_alias: string — the write alias name for this pattern (pattern + '-write')
item_fields.alias_target: string — index the write alias currently resolves to per alias data, or null if not found

diagnosis_output.description: Structured diagnosis report. Each distinct operational issue found should be reported as one entry in the issues array, classified into the most applicable category from the taxonomy.

schema.cluster_snapshot_time: ISO 8601 timestamp of the cluster state snapshot
schema.total_indices_analyzed: integer — total number of indices present in the ISM explain data

issues.description: One entry per distinct operational issue diagnosed

item_fields.severity: string — classified per the severity guidelines below
item_fields.category: string — exactly one category from the issue_category_taxonomy
item_fields.title: string — brief descriptive title
item_fields.affected_indices: array of string — sorted list of index names affected
item_fields.root_cause: string — detailed root cause analysis explaining WHY the issue occurred

summary.total_issues: integer — number of distinct issues in the issues array
summary.indices_with_stale_policy: integer — total indices with policy version mismatch
summary.indices_with_alias_issues: integer — total indices affected by alias integrity problems

issue_category_taxonomy.action_failure: An ISM action (e.g. force_merge, allocation) has failed and is blocking lifecycle progression for an index
issue_category_taxonomy.policy_version_mismatch: Indices are running an outdated policy version, causing behavioral divergence from the current policy definition
issue_category_taxonomy.allocation_failure: Shard allocation routing is failing due to a mismatch between policy configuration and cluster topology
issue_category_taxonomy.alias_integrity: A write alias is not pointing to the correct index in a rollover chain
issue_category_taxonomy.transition_deadlock: An index is stuck because transition conditions can never be satisfied under the current policy and cluster state

severity_guidelines.critical: Data loss risk or active write failures (e.g., writes going to wrong index, data unable to reach required storage tier)
severity_guidelines.high: Lifecycle progression blocked but no immediate data loss risk
severity_guidelines.medium: Suboptimal configuration without immediate operational impact

corrected_policies.description: For any ISM policy definition under /app/policies/ that contains a configuration error preventing correct cluster operation, produce a corrected version in this directory using the same filename. Only include policies that actually require changes. The corrected file must preserve the full policy structure.
